classification.habitat: Open scrub, wasteland and disturbed habitats in tropical to subtropical regions
classification.distribution: Widely distributed in the Indian subcontinent; exact local occurrence should be confirmed during field identification

identification.description: A prickly Solanum with characteristic lobed leaves, violet flowers and berry fruits; reliable identification requires examination of prickles, leaf form, inflorescence and fruit together.
identification.whole_plant: Erect, branched, prickly herb/undershrub with a robust appearance.
identification.root: Root is cylindrical to somewhat tapering; detailed pharmacognostic characters require specimen-level verification.
identification.stem: Branched green to greyish stem, commonly armed with prickles.
identification.leaf: Simple, alternate, ovate to elliptic leaves, often lobed, with prickles on the midrib or petiole in some specimens.
identification.flower: Small violet to purple, star-shaped Solanum flowers borne in clusters.
identification.fruit: Globose berry, green when immature and becoming yellowish to orange/red on maturity depending on specimen and stage.
identification.seed: Numerous small, flattened, pale yellow to brownish seeds embedded in the berry pulp.
identification.bark: Older stems may become greyish and woody; the root/stem bark should not be used as a substitute for authenticated material.
identification_points: Differentiate carefully from other Solanum species used in Ayurveda

therapeutic_actions: Traditionally used in respiratory and digestive contexts; classical indications should be interpreted with the cited Ayurvedic source
therapeutics.precautions: Use only authenticated plant material; avoid treating this educational record as an individual prescription.
therapeutics.contraindications: No dose or patient-specific contraindication is supplied here because the classical source/edition has not been text-verified in this record.
